content: This question was answered by 5 participating runs (vs. 8 runs for other questions), and all submitted answers were wrong (scores of 1 or 2). However, our IR-based QA system retrieved one excellent answer (score 4) and our hybrid IR+RQE system provided 3 excellent answers.
